textos.A divergência central está no roteiro e: The central divergence lies in the script and in the handling of the protagonist. While nearly all of those who recommend it praise the development and choices of the main character, nearly all of those who do not recommend it criticize those same attitudes throughout the narrative.
textos.Várias reviews descrevem o protagonista: Several reviews describe the protagonist as a man who acts in a childish, emotionally dependent way, creating one-sided expectations and refusing to accept the terms of the relationship.
textos.Personagem feminina vista como vilã inju: Female character seen as a wrongly blamed villain
textos.Muitas críticas argumentam que a persona: Many reviews argue that the female character is treated unfairly, being blamed even though she made her intentions clear from the start, and that the film forces a narrative that casts her as manipulative.
textos.Crítica à romantização de comportamento: Criticism of the romanticization of toxic behavior
textos.Algumas reviews apontam que o filme roma: Some reviews point out that the film romanticizes possessive attitudes and an idealized view of love, perpetuating a problematic message about relationships and gender.
textos.Roteiro e ritmo arrastados ou confusos: Slow or confusing script and pacing
textos.Há críticas sobre a estrutura narrativa: There is criticism of the non-linear narrative structure, which is considered confusing or unnecessary, as well as a slow, tiring pace that makes the experience tedious.
textos.Diversas opiniões mencionam que ambos os: Several opinions mention that both protagonists are annoying and immature, without depth, which prevents any emotional involvement with the story.
textos.Algumas reviews criticam o desfecho por: Some reviews criticize the ending for seeming to contradict the message the film tries to convey, resulting in a conclusion that sounds forced or morally ambiguous.
textos.Incompatibilidade e problemas de comunic: The couple's incompatibility and communication problems
textos.Várias reviews medianas apontam que os d: Several middling reviews point out that the two never made clear what they expected from each other, with one wanting something serious and the other restating that she did not want commitment, producing mixed signals from both sides.
textos.Idealização de Tom e falta de responsabi: Idealization of Tom and lack of emotional responsibility
textos.Parte deste grupo sustenta que o persona: A portion of this group maintains that the male character projected unrealistic expectations and preferred to fool himself rather than face reality, while others criticize the female character's lack of emotional responsibility for insisting on a bond that only confused the other person.
textos.Diversas reviews medianas afirmam que nã: Several middling reviews state that there is no right side in the story, since both he and she acted immaturely and toxically, making it hard to root for the couple.

textos.Várias reviews medianas descrevem a pers: Several middling reviews describe the female character as dull, indecisive and underdeveloped, feeling that the script gives her no depth beyond the role of a confused woman.

textos.Algumas reviews medianas elogiam a propo: Some middling reviews praise the proposal of portraying a realistic, unconventional relationship, but others find the approach pretentious, repetitive or with an ending that overvalues romantic love.
textos.Elogios à trilha sonora, atuações e foto: Praise for the soundtrack, performances and cinematography
textos.Reviews medianas destacam positivamente: Middling reviews positively highlight the music, the performances and the cinematography, acknowledging that the film manages to move and entertain even when the story does not appeal.
textos.Idealização e projeção sobre o outro: Idealization and projection onto the other person
textos.Grande parte deste grupo enxerga o cerne: A large portion of this group sees the heart of the film in the protagonist's tendency to build an imagined version of the person he loves instead of seeing her as she really is, and discusses how this mechanism of projection sustains the relationship and later destroys it.
textos.Muitas reviews desta faixa recusam a ide: Many reviews in this range reject the idea of a single villain and state that both characters act immaturely and contradictorily, albeit in different ways, making the conflict more human than Manichean.
textos.Vários comentários descrevem como a perc: Several comments describe how the perception of the film changes with each rewatch, shifting sympathy between one character and the other and revealing new layers as the viewer's life experience changes.
textos.A montagem fragmentada e a ordem cronoló: The fragmented editing and scrambled chronological order are praised as a device that imitates how memory works and gives depth to the way the protagonist reconstructs his own past.
textos.A sequência de tela dividida que contras: The split-screen sequence that contrasts what the protagonist expects with what actually happens is repeatedly pointed out as one of the film's most striking and emotionally effective moments.
textos.As escolhas musicais e o cuidado visual: The musical choices and visual care are strongly highlighted, with frequent mentions of the impact of the songs and the aesthetic identity that gives personality to the scenes and to the couple's memories.

textos.Lançada em 2009 e dirigida por Marc Webb: Released in 2009 and directed by Marc Webb, the romantic dramatic comedy (500) Days of Summer follows a romantic writer taken by surprise by the sudden end of his relationship. From that breakup, he recalls moments from the five hundred days they spent together to try to understand where the relationship went wrong, rediscovering his own passions in the process.
textos.A narrativa se constrói por meio de uma: The narrative is built through a non-linear time structure, revisiting different moments and memories of the couple's time together.
textos.Os diferentes grupos de recepção concent: The different reception groups focus on the same central themes of the couple's dynamic, diverging essentially on the verdict on how the work functions. Among the vast majority of ratings (~72%), most highlight the mechanism of idealization and the projection of expectations onto the other person as the core of the narrative. About half of this set consider that both protagonists share responsibility for the relationship's failings, while a significant share report that rewatching and revisiting the work transforms the interpretation of events.
textos.Numa perspectiva intermediária, presente: From an intermediate perspective, present in a share of the ratings (~22%), many point to incompatibility and communication failures as the decisive factor in the mismatch. In this segment, a considerable number discuss the protagonist's idealization and the partner's lack of emotional responsibility, while a smaller slice concludes that both characters are problematic in their conduct.
textos.Por fim, sob a ótica crítica presente nu: Finally, from the critical perspective present in a minimal fraction of ratings (~6%), a good portion reproach the male protagonist, considering him immature and needy. Several of these accounts understand that the female character is unfairly portrayed as a villain, while some criticize the romanticization of toxic behavior.
